FULL TEXT:
COEP TECHNOLOGICAL UNIVERSITY PUNE
(A Unitary Public University of Govt of Maharashtra)
Shivajinagar Pune
Sponsoring
organization
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION - Project
under Research Promotion Scheme (Lab to Market) 2025-26
Title of Project
Design and Optimization of Doped Ceria Electrolytes with
Sintering Aids for High-Performance Low-Temperature Solid
Oxide Fuel Cells.
Essential Qualification
Candidates possessing a Bachelor's/Master’s degree in engineering
(Metallurgical/Materials engg. and allied branches, Mechanical engg.,
Manufacturing/Production engg., Chemical engg etc.) are eligible to apply. First
class at Bachelor’s or Master’s degree level essential. Experience of working on
similar project is desirable.
Nature of Appointment
Project Assistant – Purely temporary: The Project Assistant will assist in the
execution of project-related experimental work, data collection, analysis,
documentation, and other activities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.
Position Details Post Name Duration Stipend, INR
Project Assistant 30 Months 27,000 + HRA/-

the Applications

Hard copy by
courier/post
(Application submitted
through email will not
be accepted)
30 November 2026 (Wednesday) till 5 PM
Superscribe on envelop: Appl. For Project Asst. (LT-SOFC ) Post

following address in a sealed envelope to-
Dr. S. P. Mahajan
Director (Research and Innovation)
Main administrative building, 2nd floor
COEP Technological University Pune
(A Unitary Public University of Govt of Maharashtra)
Shivajinagar, Pune – 411 005
Additional
Instructions
a) The PI/Co-PI shall not be responsible for postal/courier delay, if any, or
any other reason for non-receipt of the document at the specified time and
will result in disqualification/rejection of the application.
b) The appointment of the candidate for the post of Project Asst. is governed
by the terms and conditions of the University/ funding agency particularly
applicable in the said project.
